challenges.summary: Production identity census is accepted by the derivation helper but is not yet armed by the future live entry point.
Several no-access counters are structural zero fields without local increment sites.
Package gate accounting uses the qualification label in both modes.
Caller-supplied validation time can burn a durable reservation before the real-clock capability check.
The mutation oracle accepts any exception rather than a preregistered exception class.
Cross-readiness replay protection correctly keys the durable reservation to the human-decision digest.
Live canonical roots were absent during the no-access review.

Seven forward-hardening observations covering reverse mutation coverage, synthetic durability scope, bounded process registries, explicit workflow commands, literal ledger binding, private coordinator imports, and caller-supplied authority commit identity.
Downstream readiness attestation is not rejoined to the collapsed GO release-authority digest; one-shot identity and counts remain exact.
Package-start validation is deterministic and nonstarting but uses a qualification counter label and permits repeated validation.
Python reflection can form incomplete exact-type objects but did not bypass durable one-shot or installation markers into an attempt.
